items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: I used him as a tool. I built things around him, when he played in the band.

ctx.x: I may have a few I can call, let me see. I can't really say Roland Kirk. I'd like to say Roland Kirk, but Roland never really fit into my style. He was -- I used him as a tool. I built things around him, when he played in the band.
Barrow, I liked George Barret, the way he played in my band, too. Tenor player, from a long time ago.
